_metadata.description: Enable semantic search across all Qdrant collections using natural language queries

requirements.title: Semantic search API endpoint
requirements.description: POST /api/v1/knowledge/search endpoint accepts natural language queries and returns semantically similar results from Qdrant

requirements.title: Query vectorization via Ollama
requirements.description: Transform natural language queries into embeddings using Ollama's embedding models

requirements.title: Qdrant collection search
requirements.description: Execute vector similarity search against Qdrant collections and return ranked results

requirements.title: Search response time < 500ms
requirements.description: 95% of semantic search queries must complete in under 500ms

validation.notes: The former api/search_performance_test.go reference does not exist. Measure the promised p95 bound on a comparable representative corpus; retrieval eval latency is supporting evidence, not completion of the whole search performance requirement.
